	shield_damage = 1.25
	tracking = 1.0

	firing_arc = 30.0
	min_range = 0
	hidden = yes

	on_hit = {
		hidden_effect = {
			solar_system = {
				every_ship_in_system = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { is_same_value = root }
						controller = { is_hostile = from.controller }
						distance = {
							source = root
							max_distance <= 190
							same_solar_system = yes
						}
					}
